summary_1line: After the swayamvara fight ends, Kunti unknowingly tells her sons to share their ‘alms,’ creating the dilemma that Draupadi may become wife to all five Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima lifts the powerful king Salya in his arms during their wrestling duel and hurls him across the arena while surrounding monarchs watch in shock.
Arjuna and Bhima, disguised as Brahmanas and surrounded by ascetics in deer skins, emerge from the crowd like the sun and moon breaking through clouds.
Inside the potter’s hut, Kunti unknowingly tells her unseen sons to share their alms, then turns and sees Draupadi standing there beside them in sudden realization.
